exposure: Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II
Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation IV
cohort: Pregnant and postpartum women admitted to an obstetric ICU in a tertiary care hospital in Brazil during a 3-year period.
finding: Total Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) may be used to predict severe maternal outcome in obstetric populations admitted to ICU, and Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II) may be applied to predict severe maternal outcome in hemorrhagic complications.
